Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: William Hutcheon Hall (author, Wikidata Q8012724), died 1878; William Dallas Bernard (author, Wikidata Q75408867), died 1866. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hall, W. H. (William Hutcheon), Sir, 1797?-1878; Bernard, W. D. (William Dallas), 1808-1866") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Narrative of the voyages and services of the Nemesis from 1840 to 1843 and of the combined naval and military operations in China : comprising a complete account of the colony of Hong-Kong. And remarks on the character and habits of the Chinese, London : H. Colburn, 1844, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/b33281154. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 100%, 86% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Dallas Bernard, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
